unit.why: A single narrative told by R. Mottel of Gowarczów: the Magelnitza rebbe perceives at a distance that a young man is in danger on the road and goes out to meet him with brandy.

stories.start_quote: סיפר הרב החסיד ר׳ מאטיל הרב דק"ק גאוורטשוב
stories.summary_en: On a Friday the Magelnitza rebbe senses that a young man travelling to him is in great danger, skips his meal, goes out of town with his attendant and brandy, meets the young man who had escaped three gentiles trying to slaughter him, and explains he feared not death but that the man could not bear the fright.
